Hi Grace,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our procurement legal review we need to confirm that any inference for BioHealth customer data is processed entirely within the EU for both serving and control-plane functions, and that the SCCs you intend to rely on are supported with evidence. Specifically we need: 1) a clear statement that inference and model KV/cache do not leave EU regions (in-region compute and storage), 2) operator access boundaries and entitlements (who can access customer data and under what conditions), and 3) retention and deletion proof for both live and backup data (including snapshots).

Two practical asks to help legal and our DPO sign-off:
- A short attestation we can include in our contract annex confirming EU-only processing and SCCs reliance,
- A list of artifacts/evidence (logs, audit trace samples, backup deletion timestamps, SCCs annex acceptance) we can request during PoC.

Can you confirm timelines? We need initial responses by end of this week to keep our board timeline.

Best,

Grace / Aditya —

Draft attestation (suggested):
"Redwood Inference confirms that, for accounts configured with our EU-only processing option, all customer inference requests, model KV cache, and associated control-plane operations are executed and stored within EU data centers under Redwood's control. Redwood relies on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) where applicable; customer-specific SCC annexes will be provided and signed as part of the contractual process. Operator and support access to EU-hosted customer data is restricted to named roles under strict Just-In-Time (JIT) authorization, session recording, and audited access reviews. Backups and snapshots for EU-only instances are retained in-region and can be purged on customer request; retention and deletion evidence (audit logs, snapshot deletion timestamps) can be provided for PoC/ audit."

Notes / caveats to include in contract annex:

- If customer elects a private control plane (VPC on-prem), we should state that operator access is limited per configuration and any cross-border exports will be explicitly disallowed.

Attachments to include for PoC (minimum set):
- Signed SCCs annex (Annex A),
- Sample audit trail (session start/stop + JIT approvals) redacted,
- Backup retention table and snapshot deletion timestamps,
- KMS/HSM key custody statement,
- A short runbook describing operator escalation and emergency access process.

I can tidy the attestation wording for legal. Aditya — can you confirm the snapshot deletion cadence and where we can export deletion evidence (Cloud provider API or our internal ops DB)?

Lauren — quick operational confirmations:
- Snapshot/backups: For EU-only instances we keep daily snapshots for 30 days, weekly backups for 12 weeks, and monthly archives for 12 months by default. All snapshot objects are tagged with the customer_id and region. We can export a CSV of snapshot IDs with create/delete timestamps (see attached prototype: backup-retention-logs.csv).
- Deletion evidence: When a snapshot is deleted we record delete_event_id + timestamp in our internal operations DB. We can run a query for a given customer and date range and produce a signed export (sha256) of the result.
- KV/cache: Model KV is ephemeral in-memory and stored on local NVMe on EU nodes; we do not replicate KV outside the region for EU-only; persistent artifacts (if any) are stored in region S3 buckets.
- Operator access: Access requires JIT approval via our PAM, MFA enforced, sessions recorded to our audit log retention for 24 months. Named roles: infra-operator, infra-oncall, sec-analyst. We can provide a redacted sample session log; full logs require NDA/PoC scope.

Caveat: If customer chooses Hosted+Marketplace integrations that route telemetry to third-party monitoring (e.g., Datadog global), aggregated metrics may cross borders. We recommend dedicated control plane or explicit denial of third-party telemetry in contract.

I'll produce the export and the signed hash by EOD Thursday and attach.

Regards,
Aditya
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
